justification: The assessment uses the exact reference XOR construction. Both (X,Y) and (X,Z) are uniform on the four bit pairs, verifying the independence hypotheses. Joint independence fails because P(X=0,Y=0,Z=0)=1/4, whereas P(X=0)P(Y=0,Z=0)=1/8. Its calculation showing dependence on Y+Z is also correct.
